gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-amiko: Amiko reads modern and unfussy, its terminals flicking outward like tongs. Stentiga is best at refined, widely tracked display lines with constant-walled o's, while Amiko is best at carrying running text.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-anek-bangla: Refined and widely tracked, Stentiga draws every letter as a single steady outline. Anek Bangla lends wide, barely curled s curves and a short climb to its ascenders, keeping things approachable.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-anek-devanagari: Stentiga runs refined and luxurious, every letter drawn with uninterrupted line width and generous tracking. And Anek Devanagari settles into paragraphs easily, its open letter mouths and tall middle zone keeping text modern and unhurried.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-anek-gujarati: Anek Gujarati gives clean, approachable text, its lowercase nearly rivaling the capitals and its c opening gaping wide. Shrink Stentiga, though, and its one-gauge tubing curves lose their refined stature.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Stentiga is tubular and wire-like, refined and luxurious, with crossbars matching its stems and tracking opened up wide. Shrink the heading and Anek Gurmukhi, with open counters, takes over.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-anek-kannada: Wide, refined, a bit grand, Stentiga keeps every join full where strokes meet and its tracking generously opened up. Anek Kannada backs it with terminals stopping short and a high x-height.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-anek-malayalam: Reading Stentiga feels like following a single thread, each letter drawn wide, refined and luxuriously spaced out. Anek Malayalam sits alongside with open curve tips and tight cap-to-lowercase height.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-anek-odia: Stentiga draws pipe-cleaner strokes with wide, refined tracking. It is best at luxurious display lines, while Anek Odia is best at clean running text, with rounds left unlatched and capitals barely taller.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-anek-tamil: Anek Tamil brings big round bowls, half-unwrapped curves, while Stentiga ends each terminal at the width it began. Refined display luxury meets modern ease, and neither one crowds the other.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-anek-telugu: Stentiga leaves the single-width trail of a rolling-ball pen. Its refined, luxurious spacing meets Anek Telugu, whose wide, tall bowls and unlatched rounds set a clean, approachable rhythm.
